headline: Temporary job search grows in Mexico in an environment of fewer job offers: Indeed
summary: Searches for temporary jobs in Mexico reached their highest level in seven years, even as job vacancies begin to fall. Indeed says sales, retail and logistics offer the most opportunities.
why: Labor market indicators such as job vacancies and search activity help investors gauge employment conditions and consumer spending in Mexico.
original_headline: Búsqueda de empleo temporal crece en México en un entorno de menor ofertas de trabajo: Indeed
